subject: Hosted quickstart: endpoint mapping and rate playbook
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@payflux.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@payflux.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted quickstart: endpoint mapping and rate playbook

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo session this morning. Appreciate the clear overview of PayFlux's ingestion and fraud-scoring flows. As discussed, we think the Hosted API path will get you to a working integration fastest for the evaluation period. Below is a concise quickstart plan and an initial rate/playbook proposal so your engineers can start integration work this week.

Quickstart deliverables (what Redwood will provide):
- Staging API endpoints (separate project) for: 1) /v1/generate (chat/generation), 2) /v1/embeddings, 3) /v1/rerank
- Short-lived API key scoped to the staging project (we'll deliver via secure channel)
- Test data retention: evaluation logs retained for 7 days by default (we can change for Private later)
- Example cURL and Node/Python snippets (attached: redwood-quickstart.md)

Proposed endpoint mapping & starter rate plan (trial window):
- /v1/generate (user-facing chat + scoring): start at 60 requests/min (1 rps) per route, burst to 120 for short spikes, token cap 40k tokens/min project-level
- /v1/embeddings (batch & realtime): start at 30 requests/min, allow 4 concurrent batch jobs (per-project concurrency limit)
- /v1/rerank (low-latency scoring): start at 120 requests/min, lower token footprint per request

Why these numbers: they keep latency predictable for interactive paths while giving you room to validate load. If you expect steady high throughput (sustained >500 rps) we should discuss Dedicated capacity. For PII concerns, the Hosted eval will use ephemeral keys and the default retention policy above; if PayFlux needs VPC/on-prem for compliance, we can scope that in the next phase.

Next steps for PayFlux engineers:
1) Send a small traffic profile CSV (sample shape attached) with typical request size, tokens per request, peak RPS and steady-state RPS — this will let us fine-tune quotas.
2) Confirm which endpoints you'll integrate first (generate vs embeddings vs rerank).
3) Pick a 2-hour window this week for a short smoke test / guided onboarding.

I'll kick this off from our side once I get the traffic CSV. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want us to walk through the snippets.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-quickstart.md
From: Samira Khan <samira@payflux.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@payflux.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted quickstart: endpoint mapping and rate playbook

Thanks, Karthik — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying points from our infra team before you provision staging:  

1) Traffic profile: attaching a small CSV with hourly RPS for our fraud-scoring and embeddings pipelines (file: payflux_traffic_profile.csv). Our peak is usually during batch settlement windows (03:00–05:00 UTC) where embeddings jobs burst, and interactive scoring peaks regionally 12:00–18:00 PT.

2) Tokens & payloads: typical generate calls are ~450 tokens in/out; rerank requests are small (~50 tokens). Embeddings are ~512 tokens for batch jobs.

3) Data retention / PII: We need confirmation that hosted eval logs are not used for model training and are deleted after 7 days. Also want to confirm whether we can get a VPC option for the next phase if the first-week tests look good.

4) Can you support a short spike test at 2k RPS for 5 minutes so we can validate autoscaling behavior? If not on Hosted, we'll plan to run that on Dedicated.

We'll aim to run the smoke test Thursday 11/18 morning PT. Please let us know when the staging endpoints and key are available.

Regards,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform, PayFlux
samira@payflux.com

Attachment: payflux_traffic_profile.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@payflux.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@payflux.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted quickstart: endpoint mapping and rate playbook

Hi Samira — thanks for the profile and token estimates, that helps a lot. A few clarifications from our ops side and an updated playbook for the trial: 

Summary of what we can provision immediately (24–48 hours):
- Staging project with three endpoints (/v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank) and a scoped short-lived API key. We'll send the key via the secure link you prefer (PM or Okta-approved vault).
- Default hosted retention: logs retained for 7 days; Redwood will not use evaluation data for model training. We can extend retention or enable additional redaction on request.

Updated temporary trial quotas (suitable for your described traffic):
- Project-level token ceiling: 40,000 tokens/min (can be raised after initial smoke run)
- /v1/generate: 100 requests/min; burst to 200 for 30s
- /v1/rerank: 150 requests/min
- /v1/embeddings: 40 requests/min, plus 4 concurrent batch slots (we'll coordinate job queuing)
- Short spike testing: Hosted can support short bursts, but sustained 2k RPS will require Dedicated. We can run a controlled 5-minute spike in staging (we'll throttle at the project token ceiling and monitor).

Playbook for smoke test (Thu 11/18 morning PT):
- 09:30 PT: Redwood provisions staging endpoints & posts test key to secure vault
- 10:00 PT: Guided smoke test (15–30 mins) — start with steady 1 rps, then step to burst windows, finish with a 5-minute spike test (we'll cap at the agreed project token ceiling)
- Post-test (same day): ops will share latency and token-level cost breakdown and recommend next phase (increase hosted quotas vs. move to Dedicated)

Sample cURL to test the generate endpoint (see attached redwood-quickstart.md for full snippets):

curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <STAGING_KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":450}'

Security note: we'll deliver the staging key to your platform lead via the secure channel you confirm (we won't email keys). Also, for your audit trail, I'll attach the playbook and traffic profile to HubSpot (link below).

I'll provision staging once you confirm the smoke-test time and the secure delivery method for the key.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-quickstart.md
Related link: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/PF-2027-0891

Perfect — Thursday 11/18 at 10:00 PT works for us. Please post the staging key to our vault (Vault ID: payflux-staging-keys) and we’ll be ready for the smoke test. If you can also include the staging-api-key.txt in the secure delivery, that will speed verification.

Looking forward to the run.

Thanks,
